_comment: Editor default demo scene (step E2, docs/06-editor-roadmap.md) -- opened automatically when no scene path is given on the command line. No rigidbody: the Editor's Scene View doesn't wire a physics callback yet (read-only load, see engine::scene::LoadScene's own comment); one entity has a collider anyway (E3 step) since Collider components without a Rigidbody spawn cleanly with no warning (SpawnEntities only warns about a missing physics callback for entities that ask for a rigidbody) and it's worth the Inspector panel having a real Collider section to show. "guid" below is assets/m1_cube.glb's actual, committed Asset GUID (see assets/m1_cube.glb.meta). The middle cube's "scripts" array only does anything in Play Mode (editor/play_main.cpp) -- the Editor's own read-only Scene View has no AttachScriptFn wired up, so it just sits there like any other entity when merely viewing/editing this scene. The last entity's "parent": 2 (post-Editor-E8 hierarchy, docs/07-unity-parity-analysis.md) makes it a child of the RotateScript cube -- its own position [1.5,0,0] is local to that parent, so in Play Mode it visibly orbits as the parent spins, proving world-matrix composition through World::GetWorldMatrix() actually works, not just that a parent field exists.
